implementation.policy: Existing SYSTEM\Kernel\Debug BOOL Com1DebugAfterBoot, new default1 from Distribution DefaultRegistry. Existing registry_get in valid boot-shell task context once, explicit type4/length1/value0 only. Missing/type/length/value/read errors keep1; build-disabled COM1 cannot be enabled. implementation.admission: Boot-long Cold/Starting/Active/Closing/Released/Failed phase plus exact admitted count. Admission under existing serial owner, counter drops before owner permits preemption; SeqCst gate/recheck prevents close/admit race. Close denies new direct/queued/timer/sync writers and clears routes; cached callbacks still check admission. Failed or abandoned close retains claim. No reset/reinitialization path.
implementation.handoff: Close waits outside no-sleep owners for admitted calls, then drains existing8KB ring and exact German final notice with detected FIFO or single-byte batches. True THRE+TEMT required within3seconds and bounded polls. No metadata borrow over I/O/waits. Stuck writer failure never reacquires its metadata lock. Unknown UART/completion never marks port free. Panic/crash/shutdown cannot reactivate debug; normal new owner can configure released UART.
